remarks: Nestled on a charming historic street in one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods, 15 Gorham Avenue offers a rare opportunity to build your dream home just moments from the heart of town. This exceptional property allows for the construction of a approximately 2,500+/- square foot residence, perfectly suited for today's lifestyle while blending beautifully with the character of the surrounding historic homes. The lot features a lovely, private backyard-ideal for outdoor entertaining, gardens, or peaceful relaxation. Enjoy the convenience of a true walk-to-town location with easy access to Westport's vibrant downtown, restaurants, shops, parks, and train. Whether you envision a classic New England colonial or a thoughtfully designed modern home, this property provides the perfect setting to create something special in a highly sought-after Westport neighborhood.
